evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $45,000,000; attorneys' fees $8,000,000; clear sailing no
Our opening proposal also preserves the court’s independent review of fees and directs any unawarded fee amount to the class.
Term sheet: class fund $32,000,000; attorneys' fees $5,000,000; clear sailing no

summary: Plaintiffs raised attorneys’ fees in their opening term sheets, before any final class-relief figure was settled. Fees were then negotiated alongside class fund amounts from the first round. The transcript does not clearly show any trade of class recovery for fees, plaintiff firm self-interest, defense fee leverage, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading court declaration.
